text: 金十数据7月29日讯，中国人民银行等九部门联合印发《关于加强科技金融领域数据开发利用的通知》。《通知》围绕完善数据赋能科技金融全链条，聚焦融资对接、智能风控、产品创新等环节，引导金融机构依托科技金融领域数据库，构建科技型企业数字信用画像，打造特色的科技型企业风控投研模型，开发契合细分行业企业融资需求的科技金融产品。鼓励金融机构与相关部门合作，运用交易集中度、交易对手分布、交易对手稳定性等数据，开展产业链资金流动分析，绘制重点产业链图谱，“一链一策”精准匹配金融资源。
text_en: Jin10 Data, July 29: The People's Bank of China and eight other departments jointly issued the 'Notice on Strengthening Data Development and Utilization in Sci-Tech Finance.' The Notice focuses on enhancing the entire chain of data empowering sci-tech finance, targeting financing matching, intelligent risk control, and product innovation, guiding financial institutions to build digital credit profiles for sci-tech enterprises using sci-tech finance databases, create tailored risk control and investment research models, and develop sci-tech finance products suited to financing needs of segmented industries. It encourages financial institutions to collaborate with relevant departments, using data such as transaction concentration, counterparty distribution, and counterparty stability to conduct industry chain cash flow analysis, map key industry chains, and precisely match financial resources with a one-chain-one-policy approach.
